content.what_it_is: MATLAB comparison script for the composite-beach benchmark (BM5), Case C, H/d=0.6404 (title L102). Identical skeleton to BM5_A_Plotter.m: loads reference C.mat (L2; t, g4..g10) and model stations sta_0001..sta_0007 into n4..n10 (L4-10); model time /10 + shift=263.23 s (L12, L14-23); no-op elevation copy loop (L25-33); reference gauges to cm over first 600 samples (L35-43); waterfall stacking with skp=20 cm steps: pair k gets (10-k)*skp for gauges 4-9 (L45-63), gauge 10 unshifted (L65-66 commented). Overlaid plots measured vs model red (L68-101); title (L102); axis [268 285 -1 skp*7] (L103, i.e. ymax=140 cm consistent with the stacking); labels sec/cm (L104-105); grid (L106); commented ticks/wall remnants (L107-113). No writes.
entities: script variables: n4..n10 @L4-10, shift @L12, i @L14/L25/L35, g4..g10 (from C.mat, rescaled @L36-42), skp @L45; t from C.mat @L2

equations.ref: model time rescale and shift (n5..n10 L16-21)
reference gauges to cm, first 600 samples (L37-42)
waterfall offsets 6..1*skp (L50, L53, L56, L59, L62)

calls: clear all @L1; load @L2, @L4-10; length @L14, @L25; plot @L69, @L71, @L74, @L76, @L79, @L81, @L84, @L86, @L89, @L91, @L94, @L96, @L99, @L101; hold on; title @L102; axis @L103; xlabel @L104; ylabel @L105; grid on @L106
unresolved: Time shift 263.23 s is case-specific (A: 265.82/261.7, B: 263.82); derivation not in file; /10 rescale implies 0.1-s station time units.
Model elevations again lack the *100 cm conversion applied to the reference gauges (first 600 samples only, L35-43); the copy loop L25-33 is a no-op.
Gauge/station mapping (sta_0001->gauge 4 etc.) is implicit from the benchmark layout, external to this file.
